create_class_english_normalizer: create an EnglishNormalizer instance to normalize text for CLVP speech processing
build_number_to_words: build a number to words converter that transforms integers up to quadrillions into spelled-out English
run_normalize_numbers: run number normalization on text to convert digits, dollar amounts, ordinals, and decimals to words
expand_abbreviations_text: expand common English abbreviations like Mr., Dr., St. into their full spelled-out forms in text
test_normalize_pipeline: test the full normalization pipeline that converts unicode to ascii, normalizes numbers, and expands abbreviations
